overview: Euclid DR1 strong-lens work closed out with the ECLIPSE catalogue of 15,072 candidates and the AstroVink-TREX segmentation pipeline. Inference papers applied normalizing flows and neural posterior estimation to DESI DR1 N(z), FRB cosmology, gravitational-wave tests of general relativity and JWST retrievals. Surrogate and differentiable modelling advanced for MHD turbulence, compact-binary waveforms, rotating neutron stars and galpy. Benchmarks and releases include the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge, COSMIO cross-survey imputation, a 963-planet mass-radius benchmark, and 11 million LAMOST stellar labels.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
neural posterior estimation and normalizing flows
